name: Dangote
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FY2025+FY2024 rebuilt from the audited statements (AfricanFinancials ng-dangce); prior parse had scrambled labels | gaps filled from stockanalysis.com only where the source row reproduced an already stored figure of the SAME row within 1.5 percent of the stored value

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Profit = Profit Before Tax - Income Tax

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT), and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity

source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47627_DANGOTE_CEMENT_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
